s4_attain_by_region: SELECT h.region AS sales_region, AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN hr_bridge h ON o.employee_id = h.employee_id GROUP BY h.region ORDER BY h.region
s4_revenue_by_region: SELECT h.region AS sales_region, SUM(o.closed_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM opportunities o JOIN hr_bridge h ON o.employee_id = h.employee_id GROUP BY h.region ORDER BY h.region
s4_attain_advneg: SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o WHERE o.employee_id IN (SELECT h.employee_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id AND c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation' JOIN learners l ON cc.learner_id = l.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge h ON lower(replace(l.email, '.contractor', '')) = lower(h.work_email))
s4_attain_no_advneg: SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o WHERE o.employee_id NOT IN (SELECT h.employee_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id AND c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation' JOIN learners l ON cc.learner_id = l.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge h ON lower(replace(l.email, '.contractor', '')) = lower(h.work_email))
s4_attain_by_advneg: WITH advneg AS (SELECT DISTINCT h.employee_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id AND c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation' JOIN learners l ON cc.learner_id = l.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge h ON lower(replace(l.email, '.contractor', '')) = lower(h.work_email)) SELECT (o.employee_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM advneg)) AS completed_advneg, AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
s4_assess_emea: SELECT AVG(a.score) AS avg_assessment_score FROM assessment_scores a JOIN learners l ON a.learner_id = l.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge h ON lower(replace(l.email, '.contractor', '')) = lower(h.work_email) WHERE h.region = 'EMEA'
s4_attain_emea: SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN hr_bridge h ON o.employee_id = h.employee_id WHERE h.region = 'EMEA'
s4_attain_by_distract: WITH distract AS (SELECT DISTINCT h.employee_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id AND c.course_name = 'Intro to Spreadsheets' JOIN learners l ON cc.learner_id = l.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge h ON lower(replace(l.email, '.contractor', '')) = lower(h.work_email)) SELECT (o.employee_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM distract)) AS completed_distract, AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
s5_advneg_lift: WITH advneg AS (SELECT DISTINCT h.employee_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id AND c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation' JOIN learners l ON cc.learner_id = l.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge h ON lower(replace(l.email, '.contractor', '')) = lower(h.work_email)) SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN o.employee_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM advneg) THEN o.quota_attainment END) - AVG(CASE WHEN o.employee_id NOT IN (SELECT employee_id FROM advneg) THEN o.quota_attainment END) AS attainment_lift FROM opportunities o
